newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Fok hits new high of S$2.50.
newsitem.headline: Hong Fok hits new high of S$2.50.

text.p: Property and construction group Hong Fok Corporation hit a new year high of Singapore $2.50 in late morning trading on Wednesday.
At 0405 GMT, the shares eased off but were still up S$0.19, at S$2.42 on an active turnover of over 1.7 million shares traded.
Dealers said the activity was prompted by market rumours that the company may be making a major commercial property sale soon.
"If the sale is true, then the company will be cash-rich and it can invest in other things," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
Hong Fok officials were not immediately available for comment.
